quests.title: Through the Islands
quests.summary: Steer Skipper Cathal's boat through the islands of Lower Lough Erne to Boa Island.

steps.text: Ask the curator in Enniskillen Castle about the islands of Lower Lough Erne.
Back to Skipper Cathal on the north quay, and steer through the islands.
Meet the two-faced figure in Caldragh graveyard on Boa Island, and catch it.

quests.reward: Twaface, two slabs of Fermanagh Black Bacon and standing in Northern Ireland.

quests.title: Under the Marble Arch
quests.summary: Take the boat along the underground river in the Marble Arch Caves, and stop a caver damaging the formations.

steps.text: Take the boat along the underground river.
Stop the caver snapping stalactites in the Grand Gallery.
Tell Niamh at the cave entrance.

quests.reward: A Geopark Pin, some boxty and standing in Northern Ireland.

quests.title: The Lost Manuscript
quests.summary: Find the three pages of Brother Fiachra's gospel book, scattered by the wind from Devenish.

steps.text: Ask at Blakes of the Hollow: the publican found something blowing down the street.
A page blew up the hill to Portora Royal School. Ask the librarian.
The last page went east on the wind, as far as the eel fishery on Lough Neagh.
Take the pages back to Brother Fiachra on Devenish Island.

quests.reward: The Illuminated Page charm and standing in Northern Ireland.
